scripts.app: bun run --filter desktop tauri build --bundles app && rm -rf /Applications/sombre.app && ditto target/release/bundle/macos/sombre.app /Applications/sombre.app
scripts.check: ultracite check && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -q && cargo clippy -p sombre-desktop --all-targets -q
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter web --filter desktop --filter relay typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter web --filter desktop --filter relay test && bun test crates/cli && cargo test -q && cargo test -p sombre-desktop -q
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run --filter desktop build
